scoring_justification: Full DFT MAE recomputation and full Monte Carlo simulation are not feasible in the checker environment; instead verify MAE sign, easy-axis assignment, and relative ordering of reported values, and extract periodicity and phase shift from simulated coercivity curves.

outputs.description: Computed MAE values and easy-axis assignments for FeRh.
Monte Carlo simulated coercivity angular dependence.

output_contract.notes: Scoring verifies MAE sign and relative ordering (T3) and checks that the Monte Carlo curves show fourfold periodicity and a 45° phase shift. Absolute numerical tolerance is not applied.

steps.description: Verify MAE sign and easy-axis assignment, and relative ordering of MAE magnitudes for all four configurations.
Verify fourfold periodicity (90°) and 45° phase shift between AF and FM bilayer coercivity curves.
